mode_text: Long-only · Exit Arrows evaluated intrabar on the live price (BUY the moment an up arrow appears, SELL on a down arrow)
live_formula: value=units*price (long) else value_close; unreal=value-cost; unreal_pct=value/cost-1; net_if_sold=units*price*(1-fee)-cost; bh=alloc*price/bh_c0; balance=pool.cash+sum(value) (pool sizing) else sum(value)

rules.entry: Exit Arrow up, evaluated intrabar every ~5 s on the forming candle (live price as close): BUY at the live price at once
rules.exit: Exit Arrow down intrabar (live price crosses below the Exit SSL): SELL at once; or TP/SL
rules.fill: intrabar: live Binance price at the 5 s poll (max 1 entry + 1 exit per coin per candle, no re-entry in the exit candle); arrows only visible on the closed bar: next bar open
